Five components in the patient chart app use `ActionMenuButton2` from `@openmrs/esm-framework`. A behaviour change would reach each of them, and it would also reach one test that mocks it. I found these with a single text search of the patient chart checkout. I didn't open `openmrs-esm-core` to read `ActionMenuButton2` itself. I also didn't open the component files. I took the end lines from each file's last `export` or closing brace, so the ranges run from the import line to the end of the file and may include a few lines beyond the component.

Each component renders `<ActionMenuButton2 …>` for a button in the patient chart's action menu:

- **Order basket button:** `OrderBasketActionButton` in `esm-patient-orders-app`, which also imports `ShoppingCartIcon`.
- **Patient lists button:** `PatientListsActionButton` in `esm-patient-lists-app`.
- **Visit note button:** `VisitNoteActionButton` in `esm-patient-notes-app`.
- **Clinical forms button:** `ClinicalFormActionButton` in `esm-patient-forms-app`.
- **Task list button:** `TaskListActionButton` in `esm-patient-task-list-app`.
- **Clinical forms test:** `clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx` in `esm-patient-forms-app` imports `ActionMenuButton2` and wraps it with `vi.mocked`. A change to its props or behaviour could break that mock. I didn't read the test, so I don't have its line range and left it out of the JSON.
